node.statement: Complete W conclusion using the locally proved rectangle estimates. With the target node notation, multiplicativity and the two compression identities give D=V_1^*u_1(A)(I_1-P_1)u_1(B)V_1=T(AB)-A_1B_1 and W=V_1^*V_2^*u_2(u_1(D)(I_1-P_1)u_1(C))V_2V_1=T(V_1^*u_1(D)(I_1-P_1)u_1(C)V_1)=T(T(DC)-T(D)C_1). Substitution of D and linearity give W=T(Q), Q=T(T(AB)C)-T^2(AB)C_1-T(A_1B_1C)+T(A_1B_1)C_1. By the preceding child, contractivity of T and u_{3,0}, ||B||<=||Y||, and the isometry norms, ||W||<=||R_1(X^*)|| ||B|| ||R_0(Z)||<=3eta||X||||Y||||Z||. Thus both the exact expansion and the norm conclusion follow without importing the sibling rectangle node.
